description: This file defines the LegendEntryRenderer class responsible for rendering legend entries in charts, including layout calculations and drawing logic for line and shape markers, as well as associated text.

classes.name: LegendEntryRenderer
classes.description: Renderer class for chart legend entries, handling layout and drawing of markers and text.

methods.name: Format
methods.description: Calculates layout dimensions for the legend entry, including marker size and text positioning.

methods.name: Draw
methods.description: Renders the legend entry, including line or shape markers and associated text.
